name: Platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers scheduled handler
purpose: The single project-side module realising the Cloudflare Workers scheduled() handler shape. It is the sole holder of the Cron Trigger event reference, wires the dispatcher (TAC-3302) and event sink (TAC-3303) at boot, and emits a cronReady lifecycle event on the first successful ready-check. Consumers never touch the raw scheduled event outside this module; the handler is the one place the vendor surface lives so a future scheduling adapter (a different platform, a fake for tests) slots in without a handler re-shape.
responsibilities: Export a default { scheduled(event, env, ctx) } handler shape matching the Cloudflare Workers runtime API for scheduled events (AC-32101-1, AC-32105-1).
Wire the dispatcher (TAC-3302) at boot with the elicited routes, skew tolerance and soft budget; wire the injected event sink; emit cronReady on the sink at ready-check completion.
Never dereference other bindings on env (AC-32101-1); env.CACHE stays owned by the KV facade.

On every scheduled invocation delegate to dispatcher.dispatch(event); wrap the delegation with ctx.waitUntil per Cloudflare's documented scheduled contract so cronStalled and cronFired both land on the sink before the Worker context tears down.
internalStructure: One module exporting createScheduledHandler({ dispatcher, eventSink }) returning { scheduled, ready } where scheduled(event, env, ctx) is the Cloudflare scheduled shape and ready() performs the boot ready-check. A thin index.mjs entry glues createScheduledHandler to the dispatcher and sink factories at apply time so wrangler dev picks up the default export.
